Subject: Exception memo — CrescentHealth (DEAL-4319) — request for VP/CFO signoff

Markus — I’m requesting signoff on a structured, timebound rate exception for CrescentHealth. Below is the one-page memo and recommended guardrails; attached are the pricing model, draft SOW, and usage projections.

One-page memo (summary):
Customer: CrescentHealth (Asha Patel) — health system building an internal AI platform.
Deal: Production expected ARR $420,000 (year 1), TCV $1.1M over 24 months if they execute the ramp.
Ask: 36% discount off list on our hosted inference rate for months 4–24, with month 1–3 at pilot list pricing (no discount). Discount would apply only once production threshold hit (see floor below).
Rationales:
- Strategic GTM: Crescent is piloting with two channel partners who plan co-selling events early next year (high referral potential).
- Accelerates product validation for healthcare vertical (supporting our go-to-market narrative and benchmarks).

Financials / downside:
- If conversion fails before month 4: discount is void, customer pays retrospective list pricing for pilot months (no credits).
- Usage floor: production discount only applies if average monthly usage across months 4–6 >= 80% of committed baseline. If below floor, a prorated true-up applies for the delta.
- Minimum commitment: 12 months at production rate after month 3; early termination penalty equals remaining committed months at 50% of fees as a blunt deterrent.

Controls recommended:
1) Contract language: explicit usage floor, prorated true-up, and 12-month minimum.
2) Billing: monthly invoices with automated true-up engine; finance to monitor first three months post-production (Grace).
3) Pilot proofpoint: integration checklist (completed by customer) as gate to apply discount.

Requested decision: CFO approval to offer 36% discount under the above controls and authority to sign once legal approves SOW.

Attachments: pricing_model_v2.xlsx, SOW-draft.docx, usage-projection-q1-q4.pdf

Why we think this is acceptable: the effective blended rate over first 12 months (with pilot at list) yields ~20% unit discount vs standard list over the year; with the usage floors and prorated true-up, downside is limited. Crescent’s references and partner commitments materially increase upside.

Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
